headline: Trilegal, TT&A, DSK Legal act on Slice Small Finance Bank $100 million fundraise
sum: Slice Small Finance Bank has raised $100 million from a fundraise led by Neo Wealth, with participation from Kado Global, Moore Strategic Ventures, and Raise Financial, among other investors. Trilegal advised Slice Small Finance Bank on…
detail: Slice Small Finance Bank has raised $100 million from a fundraise led by Neo Wealth, with participation from Kado Global, Moore Strategic Ventures, and Raise Financial, among other investors. Trilegal advised Slice Small Finance Bank on this fundraise. TT&A advised Neo Prime Fund, Neo Secondaries Fund and affiliated entities (collectively “Neo”) on this fundraise. The transaction team consisted of Dushyant Bagga (Partner), Pooja Menon (Partner), Prerna Raturi (Senior Associate) and Aniya Damathia (Associate).
